zh.title: 男子疑持假登機證拒絕下機 Frontier Airlines航班全體旅客被要求下機
zh.summary: Frontier Airlines清空亞特蘭大航班；男子持假登機證拒離機
body: Frontier Airlines 在亞特蘭大清空了一架航班，原因是有一名男子被指持偽造登機證登上飛機，並拒絕離開飛機。
Simple Flying 報導，這起事件導致航班遭到清空，航空公司將機上人員全部撤離，以確保安全。
報導並未指出涉事航班號碼、具體機型或事發時間，也未說明該男子是否已遭逮捕或後續處置。
此事件目前仍在調查中，Frontier Airlines 尚未就此事件發表公開聲明。

en.title: Frontier Airlines Clears Plane After Man With Fake Boarding Pass Refuses To Leave
en.summary: Frontier cleared a flight in Atlanta after a man with a fake boarding pass allegedly refused to leave; investigation ongoing
body: Frontier Airlines cleared a flight in Atlanta after a man allegedly boarded with a fake boarding pass and refused to leave the aircraft, according to a report by Simple Flying.
The incident led to the flight being cleared, which required all passengers to deplane, ensuring safety.
The report does not specify the flight number, aircraft type, or the time of the event, nor how the passenger was eventually handled.
The incident remains under investigation as reported by Simple Flying, with no further details confirmed by Frontier Airlines at the time of publication.

zh.title: 空中巴士須月交付99架以達2026年目標；年終衝刺
zh.summary: 空中巴士須月交付99架；達2026年目標
body: Simple Flying報導，空中巴士（Airbus）為達成2026年的全年交付目標，必須在年底前每月交付99架客機。
報導指出，這將是又一次的年終衝刺，顯示空中巴士在第四季將面臨高強度的交付壓力。
此一目標涉及數量龐大的飛機交付，市場將密切關注其實際進度，相關細節仍以官方後續公佈的數據為準。
空中巴士的全年交付表現，向來是航空產業與投資人關注的重要指標。
報導中的推算，反映其下半年生產與交付節奏的規劃，但能否如期達成，仍須觀察官方後續的生產與交付數據。

en.title: Airbus Must Deliver 99 Jets a Month Through Year-End to Hit 2026 Target
en.summary: Airbus needs 99 monthly deliveries by year-end; 2026 target in sight
body: Simple Flying reports that Airbus must deliver 99 aircraft per month through the end of the year to meet its 2026 delivery target.
The report indicates this will be another year-end sprint, underlining the intense delivery pressure facing the manufacturer.
Such a target involves a substantial number of aircraft deliveries, and much of the industry and investors will track its eventual progress against official data.
Airbus delivery performance is a key indicator for the aviation sector and its shareholders.
The report's projection reflects its plans for production and delivery in the second half, but achievement remains subject to the company's subsequent manufacturing and delivery data.
